# 404 Not Found

> Privacy-first browser utilities. No ads, no trackers, no servers —
> everything runs locally in your browser.

## About

404 Not Found is a collection of small, focused web utilities for everyday tasks:
image conversion, file format transformation, text comparison, code
formatting, and more. All processing happens entirely in your browser using
JavaScript — your data never leaves your device.

Hosted at oxvx.github.io on GitHub Pages.

## Differentiators

- No ads, no trackers
- All processing happens client-side (your data stays in your browser)
- Instant results, no server roundtrip
- No cookie banners, no login walls, no newsletter popups

## Tools

Planned catalog spans 7 categories and 22 tools (all currently planned, none
yet shipped). Tools follow a hybrid bundling model: related operations are
grouped into deep "workbench" or "studio" tools, while single-purpose tools
stay standalone.

### Image
- Image studio — compress, convert (PNG/JPG/WebP/AVIF), resize, crop, EXIF view, base64 output
- EXIF strip — view and remove EXIF metadata in bulk
- Favicon generator — one image to multi-size favicons + apple-touch-icon + manifest
- SVG optimizer — SVGO-based minification

### File
- PDF studio — merge, split, compress, image↔PDF, page reorder, password set/remove

### Text
- Text workbench — case convert, slugify, sort/dedupe, escape, count, normalize, Lorem Ipsum, bulk regex replace
- Diff — side-by-side text and JSON diff with word-level highlights
- Regex tester — pattern, flags, replace, highlighted matches, cheatsheet
- Markdown studio — Markdown↔HTML, live preview, TOC, GFM

### Code
- Format workbench — JSON, SQL, HTML, CSS, JS, TS, XML, YAML, TOML with auto-detection
- JSON viewer — tree view with JSONPath query and search
- Data convert — JSON↔YAML/TOML/XML/CSV, JSON→TypeScript/Zod/JSON Schema

### Convert
- Number converter — integer base, units (length/weight/temperature/area/volume), roman numeral
- Color converter — HEX/RGB/HSL/HSV/OKLCH, picker, contrast checker, palette
- Timestamp converter — Unix/ISO/human, timezones, relative time
- Cron expression — parse, natural-language builder, next-run preview

### Encode
- Encode workbench — base64 (string + file), URL, HTML entity, text↔binary/hex/unicode
- JWT decoder — header, payload, signature verify
- Hash & HMAC — MD5/SHA-1/SHA-256/SHA-512/SHA-3, HMAC, bcrypt, file hash

### Generate
- ID generator — UUID (v1/v4/v7), ULID, nanoid, bulk
- Password generator — adjustable length, strength meter, memorable/diceware mode, bulk
- QR code — text/URL/WiFi/vCard, color and logo options, bulk

## Stack

Built with Astro, Tailwind CSS v4, and daisyUI. Source code is private; built
artifacts are deployed to the public hosting repository at
oxvx/oxvx.github.io.

## Contact

Maintained by oxvx (https://github.com/oxvx).
